observations.why: The contrast values self-held control over dependence on externally supplied access, pairing autonomy with keeping what one owns.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Keeping one's perspective is presented as the retained, self-originated asset, while the commodity substrate is not treated as the value to preserve.
The explicit framing centers intelligence as individually owned, directly appealing to self-origination and control.
